constraints.description: Pickup weekday deterministically determines the derived weekend indicator.
constraints.rationale: is_weekend is explicitly derived from pickup_day_of_week: Saturday and Sunday map to 1, while Monday through Friday map to 0.

constraints.description: Final rate code strongly determines the usual trip-origin classification, with documented driver alteration exceptions.
constraints.rationale: Trip type is automatically assigned from the metered rate but may be altered by the driver; the observed majority mapping is rate 1 to trip type 1, rate 5 to 2, and rates 2, 3, 4, and 6 to 1. The complete-table majority mapping remains below the required violation threshold.
